newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory 96/97 cocoa marketing rates out Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Ivory 96/97 cocoa marketing rates out Wednesday.

text.p: Ivory Coast has set marketing and freight rates for its 1996/97 cocoa marketing season and will approve about 45 exporters, Agriculture Minister Lambert Kouassi Konan said on Tuesday.

"The rates have been agreed," he told Reuters after an interministerial meeting on Tuesday. "The final decision will be taken tomorrow (Wednesday) by the Council of Ministers," Kouassi Konan said in an interview.

A new list of exporters is being drawn up after 41 were listed on Friday. "The figure will go up because we forgot some who were not a problem," he said. "There will be three of four others to add... We will have about 45."

He said exporters' objections to proposals put forward by the Caistab cocoa marketing board last week had been arbitrated by an interministerial review committee on Tuesday and the level of freight rates had been agreed and was "not a problem."
